describe.who: Tane, a 16-year-old boy, stocky and a bit fat with a soft round belly, warm medium-brown skin and thick eyebrows
design: HAIR: a tall glossy black pompadour swept up and forward, short at the sides and back

COAT: a long plain dark-red coat down to his calves, always worn open, with a high stand-up collar and long sleeves to the wrists; four round gold buttons in a row down the front edge on HIS RIGHT side and nothing else on it; the back of the coat is plain dark red with one centre seam
BELLY WRAP: a white sleeveless undershirt tucked into a wide white cloth wrap wound round his whole belly from chest to waist, drawn with three or four horizontal fold lines
TROUSERS: plain baggy black trousers gathered at the ankles
FEET: bare feet in wooden geta sandals: a plain light-brown wooden block sole with one black V-shaped strap between the toes
HANDS: bare hands, no gloves, no rings
FACE: round cheeks, thick black eyebrows, a wide fearless grin showing his teeth
describe.never: No pins, no badges, no emblems, no insignia, no stars, no lettering, no numbers, no logos and no brand marks anywhere on him. No toothpick, no cigarette, no weapon.

acting.run: he ploughs forward like a bull, upright with his chest and belly pushed out, elbows wide, fists clenched, grinning; the open coat flies out behind him
acting.runtop: a heavy bull-like run, elbows wide; from above his black pompadour, broad dark-red shoulders and the open coat spreading out behind him are what show
acting.charge: grinning with bared teeth the whole time, coat streaming straight out behind him; nothing else in the drawing: no barrier, no impact flash
